InitSignalingData is used to initialize signaling data.

data.description:
Security settings for controlling remote access permissions.

Each field uses `Option<bool>`:
  - `None`  — not configured (GUI: prompt user; headless: deny)
  - `Some(true)`  — always allow
  - `Some(false)` — always deny

allow_file_browse.description: Allow file browsing (list/delete files via signaling)

approval_timeout.description: Timeout for security approval requests in seconds

api_version.description: Current API version supported by the server

initialized.description: Indicates whether the system is initialized (e.g., admin password set)

signaling_url.description: Signaling server url, if not set, it will be "ws://127.0.0.1:{port}/signaling"
